# 顶端被削平，而不是整体变绿

<div style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;margin:22px 0 2px;flex-wrap:wrap">
<span style="font-size:30px;font-weight:700;color:#C4601A;line-height:1">145 / 1,112</span>
<span style="font-size:15px;color:#1E4A3C">座城市在 2025 年还有记录（<strong>13.0%</strong>）；而这两端都有数的 145 座里，绿地占比超过 40% 的城市从 <strong>11 座掉到 0 座</strong></span>
</div>

这份库里「没有值」和「值为 0」是两件事，而且 2025 那一列有 **87%** 的行是空的。先把「谁真的被记了两次」这件事画清楚，再谈绿地是多还是少——否则任何一条「全球城市在变绿 / 变秃」的趋势线，都是把不同的城市串在同一根线上。

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(knitr)
})

# 项目根：从当前目录逐级上溯找 assets/ 标记（与运行位置无关）
find_root <- function() {
  cur <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (dir.exists(file.path(cur, "assets"))) return(cur)
    up <- dirname(cur)
    if (identical(up, cur)) stop("未找到含 assets/ 的项目根目录")
    cur <- up
  }
}
root <- find_root()
source(file.path(root, "assets", "tt_theme.R"), encoding = "UTF-8")

# ---- 本周色彩（只在本周生效；共享 theme 不含任何色值）----
# 语义绑定：深松绿墨 = 主序列 / 绿地增加方向；烧琥珀 = 绿地减少方向；
# 幽灵灰绿 = 没有被记录的那一侧与 1990 端点。三个含义在三张图里不换位。
PAL <- list(
  bg   = "#FAFAF7",   # 纸面级近白：底色即面板，无卡面
  ink  = "#1E4A3C",   # 深松绿墨：主序列、绿地增加方向、图内直标
  body = "#5A6B60",   # 灰绿正文：副标题 / 脚注 / 轴标题
  grid = "#E7E9E2",   # 纸面上的唯一一组水平细网格
  rule = "#C3CBC0",   # 基线与分隔
  fade = "#B9C6BC",   # 幽灵灰绿：没被记录的年份、1990 端点
  band = "#DCE4DA",   # 分位带填充（同一绿族的低饱和版）
  loss = "#C4601A"    # 烧琥珀：唯一的暖强调色，只标「绿地减少」方向
)

# ---- 本周字体决策：两族分工 ----
# 标题走 Georgia 衬线（纸面质感），数据、轴、注记走 Segoe UI。
# 家族数 2 = TT_FAMILY_MAX，不新增第三套。首屏 KPI 不是图内文字，走页面自身字体栈。
GEO <- "Georgia"
FAM <- TT_FAMILY[["text"]]
mm  <- function(pt) pt / .pt

# 纸面主题：无卡面，panel 与页面同色，只留一条水平细网格
paper <- function() {
  tt_base(bg = PAL$bg, ink = PAL$ink, body = PAL$body, grid = PAL$grid, family = FAM) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.background       = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = PAL$bg, colour = NA),
      panel.background      = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = PAL$bg, colour = NA),
      panel.grid.major.y    = ggplot2::element_line(colour = PAL$grid, linewidth = 0.35),
      panel.grid.major.x    = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor      = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.title.position   = "plot",
      plot.caption.position = "plot",
      plot.title    = ggplot2::element_text(family = GEO, face = "bold", colour = PAL$ink,
                                            size = TT_TYPE[["title"]], hjust = 0,
                                            margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 5)),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(family = FAM, colour = PAL$body,
                                            size = TT_TYPE[["subtitle"]], hjust = 0,
                                            margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 11)),
      plot.caption  = ggplot2::element_text(family = FAM, colour = PAL$body,
                                            size = TT_TYPE[["caption"]], hjust = 0,
                                            margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 12), lineheight = 1.35),
      axis.text     = ggplot2::element_text(family = FAM, colour = PAL$body,
                                            size = TT_TYPE[["axis_text"]]),
      axis.title    = ggplot2::element_text(family = FAM, colour = PAL$body,
                                            size = TT_TYPE[["axis_title"]]),
      plot.margin   = ggplot2::margin(16, 24, 12, 16)
    )
}

fmt_n <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = "ragg_png", dpi = TT_EXPORT$dpi,
                      dev.args = list(bg = PAL$bg))

raw <- read_csv("../data/urban.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## 一、先看口径：2025 年只剩 145 座城市

```{r}
#| label: prep
#| echo: false
n_raw <- nrow(raw)
n_col <- ncol(raw)
yrs   <- sort(unique(raw$year))
y0    <- min(yrs)
y25   <- max(yrs)
stopifnot(identical(as.integer(yrs), c(1990L, 2000L, 2010L, 2020L, 2025L)))

# 表里混着两类行：城市行（有 cityCode）与区域汇总行（cityCode / cityName / sdgSubRegion 全空）。
# 汇总行不是城市，任何城市级聚合都必须先剔除，否则 Global Average 会被当成一座城市参与排序。
is_city <- !is.na(raw$cityCode)
city <- raw[is_city, ]
aggr <- raw[!is_city, ]
n_aggr <- nrow(aggr)
n_city <- n_distinct(city$cityCode)
n_ctry <- n_distinct(city$countryOrTerritoryName)
stopifnot(n_distinct(city$cityCode, city$year) == nrow(city))   # 一城一年一行

# 平衡面板：两个端点都有值的那批城市。这是本页唯一能做同城前后对比的样本。
panel_ids <- city |>
  filter(year == y25, !is.na(averageShareOfGreenAreaInCityUrbanAreaPct)) |>
  pull(cityCode)
n_panel <- length(panel_ids)
n_rest  <- n_city - n_panel

n_na25_share <- sum(is.na(city$averageShareOfGreenAreaInCityUrbanAreaPct[city$year == y25]))
n_na25_pc    <- sum(is.na(city$greenAreaPerCapitaM2[city$year == y25]))
n_na25_all   <- sum(is.na(raw$averageShareOfGreenAreaInCityUrbanAreaPct[raw$year == y25]))
n_row25      <- sum(raw$year == y25)
n_ctry_panel <- n_distinct(city$countryOrTerritoryName[city$cityCode %in% panel_ids])
n_zero       <- sum(city$averageShareOfGreenAreaInCityUrbanAreaPct == 0, na.rm = TRUE)

# ---- 图 1：两条中位线 + 各自 P25–P75 分位带 ----
band <- city |>
  mutate(grp = if_else(cityCode %in% panel_ids, "panel", "rest")) |>
  filter(!is.na(averageShareOfGreenAreaInCityUrbanAreaPct)) |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            p25 = quantile(averageShareOfGreenAreaInCityUrbanAreaPct, .25),
            med = median(averageShareOfGreenAreaInCityUrbanAreaPct),
            p75 = quantile(averageShareOfGreenAreaInCityUrbanAreaPct, .75),
            .by = c(grp, year)) |>
  arrange(grp, year)
n_band_rows <- sum(band$n)
n_band_drop <- nrow(city) - n_band_rows
stopifnot(n_band_drop == n_na25_share,
          n_distinct(band$grp) == 2)

ends <- band |> group_by(grp) |> slice_max(year, n = 1) |> ungroup() |>
  transmute(grp, yr = year, med)
med_p90 <- band$med[band$grp == "panel" & band$year == y0]
med_p00 <- band$med[band$grp == "panel" & band$year == 2000]
med_p25 <- band$med[band$grp == "panel" & band$year == y25]
med_r90 <- band$med[band$grp == "rest"  & band$year == y0]
med_r20 <- band$med[band$grp == "rest"  & band$year == 2020]
stopifnot(all(lengths(list(med_p90, med_p00, med_p25, med_r90, med_r20)) == 1))

# ---- 图 2：两端斜坡（同城 1990 vs 2025）----
wide <- city |>
  filter(cityCode %in% panel_ids, year %in% c(y0, y25)) |>
  select(cityCode, cityName, countryOrTerritoryName, sdgRegion, year,
         share = averageShareOfGreenAreaInCityUrbanAreaPct, pc = greenAreaPerCapitaM2) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = c(share, pc))
stopifnot(nrow(wide) == n_panel, !anyNA(wide$share_1990), !anyNA(wide$share_2025))

slope <- wide |>
  mutate(delta = share_2025 - share_1990,
         gain  = delta > 0,
         big_lab = sprintf("%s  %.1f\u2192%.1f", cityName, share_1990, share_2025))

n_up    <- sum(slope$gain)
n_down  <- sum(!slope$gain)
sd_90   <- sd(slope$share_1990)
sd_25   <- sd(slope$share_2025)
mean_90 <- mean(slope$share_1990)
mean_25 <- mean(slope$share_2025)
med_s90 <- median(slope$share_1990)
med_s25 <- median(slope$share_2025)
max_90  <- max(slope$share_1990)
max_25  <- max(slope$share_2025)
n_40_90 <- sum(slope$share_1990 > 40)
n_40_25 <- sum(slope$share_2025 > 40)
r_conv  <- cor(slope$delta, slope$share_1990)
n_drop10 <- sum(slope$delta <= -10)
n_rise10 <- sum(slope$delta >= 10)

# 直标挑谁：跌得最狠的 3 座 + 涨得最多的 2 座。五座在 1990 端的间距都 ≥ 5pp，不叠。
hi <- bind_rows(slice_min(slope, delta, n = 3), slice_max(slope, delta, n = 2)) |>
  arrange(share_1990) |>
  mutate(x_lab = 0.94,
         hi_dir = factor(if_else(gain, "gain", "loss"), levels = c("gain", "loss")))
stopifnot(nrow(hi) == 5, min(diff(sort(hi$share_1990))) > 5)
hi_delta <- setNames(hi$delta, hi$cityName)
top25 <- slope |> slice_max(share_2025, n = 3)

# ---- 图 3：城市规模分箱哑铃 ----
# 派生列：100 × 人均绿地 ÷ 绿地占比 = 每位居民对应的城市面积（m² / 人）。
# 这个量不在原始数据里，是本周唯一自造的列，用途只有一个——把「摊得开 / 挤得紧」分开。
dens <- slope |> mutate(area_pc = 100 * pc_1990 / share_1990) |> filter(is.finite(area_pc))
n_dens  <- nrow(dens)
n_ddens <- nrow(slope) - n_dens
brks <- unname(quantile(dens$area_pc, c(.25, .5, .75)))

bin_lv <- c("1", "2", "3", "4")
bin_nm <- c(
  sprintf("1  most compact   \u2264 %.0f m\u00b2", brks[1]),
  sprintf("2  %.0f\u2013%.0f m\u00b2", brks[1], brks[2]),
  sprintf("3  %.0f\u2013%.0f m\u00b2", brks[2], brks[3]),
  sprintf("4  most spread out   > %.0f m\u00b2", brks[3])
)

dumbbell <- dens |>
  mutate(bin = cut(area_pc, c(-Inf, brks, Inf), labels = bin_lv)) |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            s90 = median(share_1990), s25 = median(share_2025),
            q1_90 = quantile(share_1990, .25), q3_90 = quantile(share_1990, .75),
            q1_25 = quantile(share_2025, .25), q3_25 = quantile(share_2025, .75),
            up = sum(share_2025 > share_1990), down = sum(share_2025 < share_1990),
            .by = bin) |>
  mutate(lab   = bin_nm[as.integer(bin)],
         y     = 5L - as.integer(bin),          # 规模档 1 在最上
         rise  = s25 > s90,
         h90   = if_else(s90 < s25,  1.35, -0.35),
         h25   = if_else(s25 > s90, -0.35,  1.35)) |>
  arrange(bin)
stopifnot(nrow(dumbbell) == 4, sum(dumbbell$n) == n_dens)

# ---- 官方三问的答案 ----
pc_n <- city |> filter(!is.na(greenAreaPerCapitaM2)) |> count(year, name = "n_with_pc")
leaders <- city |>
  filter(!is.na(greenAreaPerCapitaM2)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  slice_max(greenAreaPerCapitaM2, n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(pc_n, by = "year") |>
  arrange(year) |>
  transmute(year, cityName, countryOrTerritoryName,
            pc = greenAreaPerCapitaM2, share = averageShareOfGreenAreaInCityUrbanAreaPct,
            n_with_pc)
stopifnot(nrow(leaders) == length(yrs))

region_tbl <- slope |>
  summarise(n = n(), s90 = median(share_1990), s25 = median(share_2025),
            up = sum(gain), .by = sdgRegion) |>
  mutate(d = s25 - s90) |>
  arrange(s90)
n_reg <- nrow(region_tbl)
ea_row <- region_tbl$d[region_tbl$sdgRegion == "Eastern Asia and South-eastern Asia"]
eu_row <- region_tbl$d[region_tbl$sdgRegion == "Northern America and Europe"]

r_sp90 <- cor(city$averageShareOfGreenAreaInCityUrbanAreaPct[city$year == y0],
              city$greenAreaPerCapitaM2[city$year == y0], use = "complete.obs")
r_sp25 <- cor(city$averageShareOfGreenAreaInCityUrbanAreaPct[city$year == y25],
              city$greenAreaPerCapitaM2[city$year == y25], use = "complete.obs")

n_reg_all  <- n_distinct(raw$sdgRegion)
n_reg_city <- n_distinct(city$sdgRegion)
n_foot     <- n_distinct(raw$footNote)
n_dupname  <- sum(duplicated(unique(city[, c("cityCode", "cityName")])$cityName))
n_us <- sum(city$countryOrTerritoryName == "United States of America") / length(yrs)
n_in <- sum(city$countryOrTerritoryName == "India") / length(yrs)
ga_1990    <- aggr$averageShareOfGreenAreaInCityUrbanAreaPct[aggr$year == y0 &
                aggr$countryOrTerritoryName == "Global Average"]
mean_1990  <- mean(city$averageShareOfGreenAreaInCityUrbanAreaPct[city$year == y0])
```

```{r}
#| label: flow-line
#| echo: false
flow_cov  <- tt_flow(n_raw, n_panel,
                     sprintf("%d 行是区域汇总（每年 8 行，不是城市）", n_aggr),
                     sprintf("%d 座城市没有 2025 记录", n_rest))
flow_band <- tt_flow(nrow(city), n_band_rows,
                     sprintf("%d 行 2025 为空，画不出点", n_band_drop))
flow_dens <- tt_flow(n_city, n_dens,
                     sprintf("%d 座没有 2025 记录", n_rest),
                     "Gomel 1990 年占比与人均同为 0，面积算不出来")
```

> `r flow_cov`

**40 行不是城市。** 每年 8 行是区域汇总（`cityCode`、`cityName`、`sdgSubRegion` 三列全空），其中一行叫 `Global Average`；它的 1990 年值是 `r sprintf("%.4f", ga_1990)`，而 `r fmt_n(n_city)` 座城市当年的简单均值是 `r sprintf("%.4f", mean_1990)`——差 0.02 个百分点，可见汇总行就是城市行的简单平均。把它留在表里跑排序，`Global Average` 会挤进「绿地占比最高的城市」名单。

```{r}
#| label: fig-band
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Two medians 4.2 points apart in 1990 and 2.1 points apart in 2020: the 145 cities that got a 2025 record were the barer half of the database from the start."
#| fig-width: 9.4
#| fig-height: 5.8
p1 <- ggplot(band, aes(x = year, group = grp)) +
  # 主序列的中间一半画成实心带；参照组不填色、只留虚线外框，否则实心带会把它的上下沿遮掉。
  geom_ribbon(data = filter(band, grp == "panel"),
              aes(ymin = p25, ymax = p75), fill = PAL$band, colour = NA) +
  geom_ribbon(data = filter(band, grp == "rest"),
              aes(ymin = p25, ymax = p75), fill = NA, colour = PAL$fade,
              linetype = "22", linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_line(aes(y = med, colour = grp, linetype = grp), linewidth = 0.95) +
  geom_point(aes(y = med, colour = grp), size = 2.0) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2002.6, xmax = 2005.8, ymin = 21.8, ymax = 22.6,
           fill = PAL$band, colour = PAL$ink, linewidth = 0.3) +
  annotate("text", x = 2006.9, y = 22.2,
           label = sprintf("%s cities with a 2025 record", fmt_n(n_panel)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, colour = PAL$ink, family = FAM,
           size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]])) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 2002.6, xmax = 2005.8, ymin = 20.4, ymax = 21.2,
           fill = NA, colour = PAL$fade, linetype = "22", linewidth = 0.45) +
  annotate("text", x = 2006.9, y = 20.8,
           label = sprintf("%s cities whose record stops at 2020", fmt_n(n_rest)),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, colour = PAL$body, family = FAM,
           size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]])) +
  geom_text(data = ends, aes(x = yr + 0.45, y = med, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", med)),
            colour = PAL$ink, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.4, family = FAM,
            fontface = "bold", size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]]), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(panel = PAL$ink, rest = PAL$fade), guide = "none") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(panel = "solid", rest = "22"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = yrs, limits = c(1988, 2028), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20), limits = c(0, 24.2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title    = "The cities that got a 2025 record were the barer half all along",
    subtitle = paste("Median share of green area and the middle half (P25\u2013P75),",
                     "split by whether the city has a 2025 record"),
    x = "year (five satellite snapshots)",
    y = "green area as a share of the city area (%)",
    caption  = tt_source("urban.csv", fmt_n(n_band_rows),
      sprintf(paste0("city rows only; the %s aggregate rows are excluded. Share is the ",
                     "satellite-derived average over each city polygon, so a move can mean ",
                     "greening or a redrawn boundary. The %s cities with no 2025 value are ",
                     "dropped from the 2025 point, never read as zero, so from 2020 onward ",
                     "the two series describe different cities and their gap is a selection ",
                     "difference rather than a change over time. The last median point of the ",
                     "lower group is 2020, not 2025."),
              fmt_n(n_aggr), fmt_n(n_rest)))
  ) +
  paper() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)))
p1
```

**读数**：两条中位线在靠近，但靠近的方式是**上面那条在掉**，不是下面那条追上来。`r fmt_n(n_rest)` 座没有 2025 记录的城市，中位占比从 1990 年的 `r sprintf("%.1f", med_r90)`% 一路降到 2020 年的 `r sprintf("%.1f", med_r20)`%。跌了 `r sprintf("%.1f", med_r90 - med_r20)` 个百分点。

有 2025 记录的那 `r n_panel` 座正相反，起点只有 `r sprintf("%.1f", med_p90)`%。它先跌到 2000 年的 `r sprintf("%.1f", med_p00)`%，之后回到 `r sprintf("%.1f", med_p25)`%。

也就是「被记了两次的那批」在 2000 年之后是**往上走**的，而只被记到 2020 年的那批一路向下。但这张图不能证明任何一方在变绿。

能画到 2025 的这 `r n_panel` 座城市，1990 年的中位占比只有其余 `r fmt_n(n_rest)` 座的一半。`r sprintf("%.1f", med_p90)`% 对 `r sprintf("%.1f", med_r90)`%，**它们从一开始就是更秃的那一半**，两条线本来就不能互当对照。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-band
#| echo: false
band |>
  mutate(组 = if_else(grp == "panel",
                      sprintf("%d 座（两端都有记录）", n_panel),
                      sprintf("%d 座（2025 无记录）", n_rest))) |>
  transmute(组, 年份 = year, `城市数` = n,
            `P25 %` = sprintf("%.2f", p25), `中位数 %` = sprintf("%.2f", med),
            `P75 %` = sprintf("%.2f", p75)) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "图 1 的原始数字（同一份聚合；2025 行缺失 = 该组在 2025 年没有记录，不是 0）")
```

## 二、两端都有数的 145 座：占比在顶端被削平

```{r}
#| label: fig-slope
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "All eleven cities above 40% green in 1990 sit below 35% in 2025, while the median city moved the other way and gained 0.9 points."
#| fig-width: 9.4
#| fig-height: 6.6
p2 <- ggplot(slope) +
  geom_segment(data = filter(slope, !gain),
               aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = share_1990, yend = share_2025),
               colour = PAL$loss, alpha = 0.40, linewidth = 0.30, lineend = "round") +
  geom_segment(data = filter(slope, gain),
               aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = share_1990, yend = share_2025),
               colour = PAL$ink, alpha = 0.40, linewidth = 0.30, lineend = "round") +
  geom_segment(data = hi, aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = share_1990, yend = share_2025,
                              colour = hi_dir),
               linewidth = 1.05, lineend = "round") +
  geom_point(data = hi, aes(x = 1, y = share_1990, colour = hi_dir), size = 2.1) +
  geom_point(data = hi, aes(x = 2, y = share_2025, colour = hi_dir), size = 2.1) +
  geom_text(data = hi, aes(x = x_lab, y = share_1990, label = big_lab, colour = hi_dir),
            hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, family = FAM, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]]),
            fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2.42, y = 40, yend = 40, colour = PAL$body,
           linewidth = 0.42, linetype = "22") +
  annotate("text", x = 2.42, y = 41.3, label = "40%", hjust = 1, vjust = 0,
           colour = PAL$body, family = FAM, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["caption"]])) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.42, y = 64,
           label = sprintf("%d of these cities were above 40%% in 1990, %d in 2025",
                           n_40_90, n_40_25),
           hjust = 1, vjust = 0, colour = PAL$loss, family = FAM,
           fontface = "bold", size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]])) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.42, y = 76,
           label = sprintf("%d cities down  \u00b7  %d up", n_down, n_up),
           hjust = 1, vjust = 0, colour = PAL$body, family = FAM,
           size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]])) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(gain = PAL$ink, loss = PAL$loss), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2), labels = c("1990", "2025"),
                     limits = c(0.28, 2.42), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 20, 40, 60), limits = c(-2.5, 78), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title    = "The top of the distribution was cut off, not greened over",
    subtitle = sprintf(paste("Share of city area that is green in the %d cities with a",
                             "record at both ends; one line per city, coloured by direction"),
                       n_panel),
    x = NULL, y = "green area as a share of the city area (%)",
    caption  = tt_source("urban.csv", fmt_n(n_panel),
      sprintf(paste0("slope lines carry direction only (deep green = the city gained ",
                     "share, burnt amber = it lost share); the five labelled lines are the ",
                     "three largest falls and the two largest rises, tagged with their 1990 ",
                     "and 2025 values. Standard deviation falls from %.1f to %.1f points ",
                     "while the median rises from %.2f%% to %.2f%%, which is what flattening ",
                     "at the top looks like. Every value is a share of that city polygon, so ",
                     "a boundary redrawn between snapshots moves a point with no vegetation ",
                     "change behind it."),
              sd_90, sd_25, med_s90, med_s25))
  ) +
  paper() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(colour = PAL$ink, face = "bold",
                                   size = TT_TYPE[["axis_title"]]),
        axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)))
p2
```

**读数**：`r n_down` 座跌、`r n_up` 座涨，而中位数是**涨的**。它从 `r sprintf("%.2f", med_s90)`% 升到 `r sprintf("%.2f", med_s25)`%，均值却反向。

均值 `r sprintf("%.1f", mean_90)`% → `r sprintf("%.1f", mean_25)`%。标准差也从 `r sprintf("%.1f", sd_90)` 缩到 `r sprintf("%.1f", sd_25)`。最大值从 `r sprintf("%.1f", max_90)`% 掉到 `r sprintf("%.1f", max_25)`%。

**掉的是顶端**：1990 年 40% 以上的 `r n_40_90` 座城市，到 2025 年一座不剩。起点与变化量的相关系数是 `r sprintf("%.2f", r_conv)`，起点越高跌得越多——这是均值回归的形态，不是「所有城市都在失去绿地」。

跌得最狠的是 **Bissau**，`r sprintf("%.1f", hi$share_1990[hi$cityName == "Bissau"])`% → `r sprintf("%.1f", hi$share_2025[hi$cityName == "Bissau"])`%（`r sprintf("%+.1f", hi_delta[["Bissau"]])` 个百分点）。涨得最多的是 **León**（尼加拉瓜），`r sprintf("%.1f", hi$share_1990[hi$cityName == "León"])`% → `r sprintf("%.1f", hi$share_2025[hi$cityName == "León"])`%。

**不能推的结论**：这是 `r n_panel` 座城市（`r n_ctry_panel` 个国家）的构成变化，不是全球城市的面貌变化。

全库 `r fmt_n(n_city)` 座里 `r fmt_n(n_rest)` 座根本没有第二次观测。而这 `r n_panel` 座本身就是「更秃的一半」——把它们的变化当成世界趋势，会系统性高估绿地流失。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-slope
#| echo: false
bind_rows(
  slope |> slice_min(delta, n = 3) |> mutate(方向 = "跌得最狠"),
  slope |> slice_max(delta, n = 2) |> mutate(方向 = "涨得最多"),
  top25  |> mutate(方向 = "2025 最高")
) |>
  transmute(方向, 城市 = cityName, 国家 = countryOrTerritoryName, 区域 = sdgRegion,
            `1990 %` = sprintf("%.1f", share_1990),
            `2025 %` = sprintf("%.1f", share_2025),
            `变化 pp` = sprintf("%+.1f", delta)) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "图 2 的原始数字（同一批 145 座城市；末三行是 2025 年占比最高的三座，用来看顶端被削到什么程度）")
```

## 三、越挤的城市跌得越多，越铺开的反而涨

```{r}
#| label: fig-dumbbell
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Cities packed into under 97 square metres of urban land per resident lost 4.2 points of green share; the most spread-out quartile gained 2.6."
#| fig-width: 9.4
#| fig-height: 5.0
p3 <- ggplot(dumbbell) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = s90, xend = s25, y = y, yend = y, colour = rise),
               linewidth = 1.5, lineend = "round") +
  geom_point(aes(x = s25, y = y, colour = rise), size = 3.4) +
  # 中间两档的两个中位数几乎重合（7.03 对 6.84），1990 点画小一号叠在上面，
  # 这样「几乎没动」是看得见的，而不是被盖成一个点。
  geom_point(aes(x = s90, y = y), colour = PAL$fade, size = 2.1) +
  geom_text(aes(x = s90, y = y, label = sprintf("%.1f", s90), hjust = h90),
            colour = PAL$body, family = FAM, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]]),
            vjust = -1.15) +
  geom_text(aes(x = s25, y = y, label = sprintf("%.1f", s25), hjust = h25),
            colour = PAL$ink, family = FAM, fontface = "bold",
            size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]]), vjust = -1.15) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 0.35, y = y - 0.30,
                label = sprintf("n = %d   \u00b7   %d up / %d down", n, up, down)),
            colour = PAL$body, family = FAM, hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
            size = mm(TT_TYPE[["caption"]])) +
  annotate("point", x = 1.9, y = 4.92, colour = PAL$fade, size = 3.4) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.7, y = 4.92, label = "1990", hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
           colour = PAL$body, family = FAM, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]])) +
  annotate("point", x = 6.4, y = 4.92, colour = PAL$ink, size = 3.4) +
  annotate("text", x = 7.2, y = 4.92, label = "2025", hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
           colour = PAL$body, family = FAM, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]])) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = PAL$loss, `TRUE` = PAL$ink), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 5, 10, 15, 20), limits = c(0, 23.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = dumbbell$y, labels = dumbbell$lab,
                     limits = c(0.45, 5.15), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title    = "The tighter the city, the deeper the green share fell",
    subtitle = sprintf(paste("Median share of green area by quartile of 1990 urban land",
                             "per resident, the %d cities with both endpoints"),
                       n_dens),
    x = "green area as a share of the city area (%)", y = NULL,
    caption  = tt_source("urban.csv", fmt_n(n_dens),
      sprintf(paste0("urban land per resident is a derived column, 100 x green area per ",
                     "capita / green share, i.e. square metres of city polygon behind each ",
                     "resident; quartile cuts at %.0f, %.0f and %.0f m2. Dots are group ",
                     "medians, so the bar length is the median move, not an individual ",
                     "city. %d of the %d cities is missing: Gomel reports 0 for both fields ",
                     "in 1990, so the ratio has no value. The grouping uses the 1990 ratio ",
                     "only, which is fixed before the outcome and therefore not chosen to ",
                     "fit it."),
              brks[1], brks[2], brks[3], n_ddens, nrow(slope)))
  ) +
  paper() +
  theme(axis.text.y  = element_text(colour = PAL$ink, size = TT_TYPE[["axis_text"]]),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 6)),
        plot.margin  = margin(16, 24, 12, 16))
p3
```

**读数**：最紧凑的一档跌得最多，最铺开的一档反而涨。最紧凑的一档（每位居民背后的城市面积 ≤ `r sprintf("%.0f", brks[1])` m²）中位占比从 `r sprintf("%.2f", dumbbell$s90[1])`% 掉到 `r sprintf("%.2f", dumbbell$s25[1])`%。

跌了 `r sprintf("%.1f", abs(dumbbell$s25[1] - dumbbell$s90[1]))` 个百分点。`r dumbbell$n[1]` 座里只有 `r dumbbell$up[1]` 座变绿。

最铺开的一档（> `r sprintf("%.0f", brks[3])` m²）反过来：从 `r sprintf("%.2f", dumbbell$s90[4])`% 涨到 `r sprintf("%.2f", dumbbell$s25[4])`%。`r dumbbell$n[4]` 座里反过来有 `r dumbbell$up[4]` 座变绿。

**中间两档几乎不动**：第二档 `r sprintf("%.2f", dumbbell$s90[2])`% → `r sprintf("%.2f", dumbbell$s25[2])`%。第三档 `r sprintf("%.2f", dumbbell$s90[3])`% → `r sprintf("%.2f", dumbbell$s25[3])`%。

这是第二节「顶端被削平」的另一面。挤得紧的城市 1990 年绿地占比本来就高（第一档中位 `r sprintf("%.1f", dumbbell$s90[1])`%），起点高所以跌得多；铺开的城市起点低得多（`r sprintf("%.1f", dumbbell$s90[4])`%），涨一点就显得可观。

每档只有 `r dumbbell$n[1]` 座，档内的中间一半跨度很宽：最紧凑档 1990 年从 `r sprintf("%.1f", dumbbell$q1_90[1])`% 到 `r sprintf("%.1f", dumbbell$q3_90[1])`%。所以这 4 组的中位数差异只能读成方向，不能读成效应大小。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-dumbbell
#| echo: false
dumbbell |>
  transmute(规模档 = lab, `城市数` = n,
            `1990 中位 %` = sprintf("%.2f", s90), `1990 P25` = sprintf("%.2f", q1_90),
            `1990 P75` = sprintf("%.2f", q3_90),
            `2025 中位 %` = sprintf("%.2f", s25), `2025 P25` = sprintf("%.2f", q1_25),
            `2025 P75` = sprintf("%.2f", q3_25),
            `变化 pp` = sprintf("%+.2f", s25 - s90),
            `变绿 / 变秃` = sprintf("%d / %d", up, down)) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "图 3 的原始数字（面积档按 1990 年的派生列四分位切分；P25 / P75 只在本表出现，图上不画，避免压盖）")
```

## 四、官方三问的答案，以及它们各自的边界

作者问了三件事。前两问在整张表上都有答案，但第三问「1990 年以来变化最大的城市」**只能在 `r n_panel` 座城市里回答**——其余 `r fmt_n(n_rest)` 座没有第二个观测点，它们既不算跌也不算涨。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-official
#| echo: false
leaders |>
  transmute(年份 = year, 城市 = cityName, 国家 = countryOrTerritoryName,
            `人均绿地 m2` = sprintf("%.1f", pc),
            `绿地占比 %` = sprintf("%.1f", share),
            `当年有该字段的城市数` = n_with_pc) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "问一：每一年人均绿地最多的城市（只在 city rows 内排序；2025 只有 144 座城市有该字段，那一行的「最多」只在 144 座内成立）")
```

人均绿地的榜首在 5 个年份里只换过 2 次：1990 年是刚果（金）的 Bunia，2000 / 2010 / 2020 三年都是埃及尼罗河三角洲的小城 Fāqūs，2025 年是印度的 Kozhikode。

这类地方的共同点是城市面积极小、人口密度低，人均绿地于是被除法放大。`share` 与 `pc` 的相关系数 1990 年是 `r sprintf("%.2f", r_sp90)`、2025 年是 `r sprintf("%.2f", r_sp25)`，两者高度同步但不相等。

**同一份数据里「占比」和「人均」会给出不同的榜首**，这不是矛盾，是两个分母：城市面积与人口。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-region
#| echo: false
region_tbl |>
  transmute(区域 = sdgRegion, `城市数` = n,
            `1990 中位 %` = sprintf("%.2f", s90),
            `2025 中位 %` = sprintf("%.2f", s25),
            `变化 pp` = sprintf("%+.2f", d),
            `涨的城市数` = up) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "问二 / 问三：同一批 145 座城市按 UN SDG 区域的 1990→2025 中位占比（区域名取自城市行本身，不重编码、不合并新旧命名；n < 5 的行只作交代，不作结论）")
```

区域的跨度明显大于城市规模的跨度。**东亚与东南亚跌 `r sprintf("%.1f", abs(ea_row))` 个百分点**：`r region_tbl$n[region_tbl$sdgRegion == "Eastern Asia and South-eastern Asia"]` 座里仍有 `r region_tbl$up[region_tbl$sdgRegion == "Eastern Asia and South-eastern Asia"]` 座是涨的，这一格是被几座极端下跌拉下来的。

北美与欧洲则涨 `r sprintf("%.1f", eu_row)` 个百分点。相比之下，图 3 的 4 个规模档只从 `r sprintf("%.1f", min(dumbbell$s25 - dumbbell$s90))` 到 `r sprintf("%.1f", max(dumbbell$s25 - dumbbell$s90))` 个百分点。

`Australia and New Zealand` 只有 `r region_tbl$n[region_tbl$sdgRegion == "Australia and New Zealand"]` 座、`Oceania excluding Australia and New Zealand` 只有 `r region_tbl$n[region_tbl$sdgRegion == "Oceania excluding Australia and New Zealand"]` 座，这两行不能读成区域结论。

## 数据异常（记录，不改数据）

| 现象 | 原始数字 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2025 年大面积空白 | 该年 `r fmt_n(n_panel)` / `r fmt_n(n_city)` 座城市有占比（`r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * n_panel / n_city)`%）；全表该年 `r fmt_n(n_na25_all)` / `r fmt_n(n_row25)` 行为空（含 8 行汇总） | 一律按「没记录」处理，不填 0、不插值；所有涉及 2025 的图只用这 `r n_panel` 座平衡面板，并在图注写明 |
| 人均绿地比占比还少一格 | 2025 年 `greenAreaPerCapitaM2` 有 `r fmt_n(n_city - n_na25_pc)` 座城市有值，占比有 `r fmt_n(n_city - n_na25_share)` 座；差的这一座是 Mendoza（阿根廷），占比 6.08%、人均为空 | 该城在人均相关处单独缺席，不补 |
| `share` 与 `pc` 同时为 0 的记录 | `r n_zero` 处（Gomel 1990、Suva 2000、Rivne 2000、Juiz De Fora 2000、Guixi 2000、Nairobi 2010、Messina 2010、Caracas 2020、Douai-Lens 2020），每一处都夹在前后非零的年份之间 | 记为「被记成 0」，不入图做趋势；Gomel 因 0/0 被排除在图 3 的规模分档外 |
| 表里混着区域汇总行 | 每年 8 行、共 `r n_aggr` 行，`cityCode` / `cityName` / `sdgSubRegion` 全空；`Global Average` 1990 值为 `r sprintf("%.4f", ga_1990)`，城市行简单均值 `r sprintf("%.4f", mean_1990)` | 全库统一用 `!is.na(cityCode)` 分流，汇总行不参与任何城市级聚合与排序 |
| 区域名两套并存 | 城市行 `r n_reg_city` 个区域名；汇总行另用 4 个旧名（`Central and Southern Asia`、`Eastern and South-eastern Asia`、`Global Average`、`Western Asia and Northern Africa`），全表共 `r n_reg_all` 个字符串 | 按字面分组会得到 `r n_reg_all` 个区域而不是 `r n_reg_city` 个；本页只对城市行分组，且不合并新旧名 |
| 区域名里有不换行空格 | `Western Asia and Northern Africa` 存在一个用 U+00A0 的克隆，与普通空格版肉眼不可分（各 5 行，全部是汇总行） | 不做字符串归一、不合并——这是「按字面分组会多出区域」的直接来源 |
| 城市名重复 | `r n_dupname` 个名字各对应两座城（Barcelona ES/VE、London CA/GB、Santiago CL/DO、Hamilton CA/NZ、Granada NI/ES、Toledo ES/US、Valencia ES/VE） | 一律按 `cityCode` 聚合与直标，不用 `cityName` 去重 |
| `footNote` 三种版本，且预告了 2025 的覆盖 | `r n_foot` 种（153 / 915 / 921 字符）；921 字版写「population … 1990, 2000, 2010, 2020 and 2025」，915 字版只写到 2020 | 921 版覆盖的 144 座城全部有 2025 人均绿地；915 版 968 座里只有 Mendoza 有 2025 占比且无人均。这是「2025 谁被记」的唯一公开线索 |
| 两个指标都是派生量 | `greenAreaPerCapitaM2` = 绿地面积 ÷ GHS-Pop 人口；城市边界由 Degree of Urbanization 生成，不等于行政边界 | 「人均」与「占比」两个榜首因此可以不同；边界若在两次快照之间重画，点会移动但没有植被变化 |
| 自造列 | 图 3 的 `urban land per resident = 100 × pc_1990 ÷ share_1990` 不在原始数据里 | 只用 1990 年这一列做分组，`r n_ddens` 座城市（Gomel）因 0/0 被排除，图注写明 |

## 方法与口径

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 数据 | `data/urban.csv`（`r fmt_n(n_raw)` × `r n_col`）；一城一年一行，`r fmt_n(n_city)` 座城市 × `r length(yrs)` 年 + `r n_aggr` 行区域汇总 |
| 覆盖 | `r n_ctry` 个国家 / 地区；城市行 `r n_reg_city` 个 UN SDG 区域；年份固定 1990 / 2000 / 2010 / 2020 / 2025 |
| 入图样本（图 1） | `r flow_band` |
| 入图样本（图 2） | `r tt_flow(nrow(city), n_panel, sprintf("%d 座城市没有 2025 记录，两端无法成对", n_rest))` |
| 入图样本（图 3） | `r flow_dens` |
| 图 1 口径 | 城市行按「2025 是否有占比」分两组，各画中位数与 P25–P75；两组不是同一批城，2020 之后不可互当对照 |
| 图 2 口径 | `r n_panel` 座平衡面板，同城 1990 与 2025 占比之差；颜色只表方向、不代表类别；标注的 5 座是最大 3 跌 + 最大 2 涨 |
| 图 3 口径 | `r n_dens` 座；分组用 1990 年的派生面积列（固定在结果之前），组内比较 1990 与 2025 的中位数 |
| 不作为证据的列 | `dataSource`（单值，无信息）；`footNote`（长文本，只用于解释 2025 的覆盖，不做分组）；`sdgSubRegion`（对汇总行为空，且与 `sdgRegion` 强嵌套，二选一即可） |
| 不画的东西 | 不画全球时间趋势线把 1,112 座与 145 座混在一根线上（分母换人，趋势是伪的）；不按国家排名（美国 `r sprintf("%.0f", n_us)` 座、印度 `r sprintf("%.0f", n_in)` 座，中心定义差异会主导排名）；不用均值（顶端下跌会把均值拉走，与中位数反向）；不画 2025 的人均绿地分布（只有 144 座，且这 144 座是被 `footNote` 版本挑出来的，不是随机子集） |
| 数字来源 | 正文所有数字来自本页 prep chunk 的同一份聚合；内联数字一律经 `sprintf` / `format` 定型，避开 knitr 对浮点数的默认格式化 |

```{r}
#| label: typography-audit
#| include: false
audit <- bind_rows(
  tt_audit(p1) |> mutate(图 = "图 1", .before = 1),
  tt_audit(p2) |> mutate(图 = "图 2", .before = 1),
  tt_audit(p3) |> mutate(图 = "图 3", .before = 1)
)
n_size_used <- n_distinct(audit$size[!is.na(audit$size)])
n_family    <- n_distinct(audit$family[!is.na(audit$family)])
n_off       <- sum(!audit$in_ladder)
stopifnot(n_size_used <= TT_TYPE_MAX, n_family <= TT_FAMILY_MAX, n_off == 0)
cat(sprintf("typo-audit: sizes %d/%d, families %d/%d, off-ladder %d\n",
            n_size_used, TT_TYPE_MAX, n_family, TT_FAMILY_MAX, n_off), file = stderr())
```
